exposure: screening of pregnant women for Chlamydia trachomatis vaginal infections
screening of pregnant women for Neisseria gonorrhoeae vaginal infections
cohort: The study collected data on 1,041,384 neonates born in 302 Italian birth centers over a three-year period.
finding: The survey revealed a low incidence of neonatal conjunctivitis due to Neisseria gonorrhoeae or Chlamydia trachomatis in Italy.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for the three years prior to the survey.
